meta.scope: src/**/*.{css,scss} (excluding src/styles/figma-tokens.css) + src/**/*.{ts,tsx,js} colour literals, inline style objects, SVG attrs
notes: kind=color records each colour literal once; colours inside var() fallbacks are NOT counted as color, they appear as kind=var-fallback.
A colour inside a gradient or shadow is recorded both as color and as the gradient/box-shadow value.
fallbackMatchesToken=false means the hard-coded fallback differs from the token's actual value (stale fallback).
source for TS: tsx-inline-style (style={{}} / CSSProperties), svg-attr-in-ts (fill=/stroke= etc.), ts-literal (JS constants, canvas, generated Lottie markup).
